project_name: Cygnus AI Labs — Single-Page Marketing Blueprint

brand_identity.name: Cygnus AI Labs
brand_identity.positioning: AI automation and intelligence company with a long-horizon ambition toward superintelligence.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Intellectually confident, cinematic, alive with movement, credible, human-directed, ultra-precise
brand_identity.era_aesthetic: 2050 DeepTech Laboratory & Orbital Research Observatory (Human-directed editorial design)
brand_identity.emblem_motif: Swan-like constellation geometry inside an orbital ring with plotted dots and a sharp 4-point star

forbidden_elements: Purple gradients (#7351B7 or similar soft AI glow)
Robot heads, cyborg faces, glowing human brains, or sci-fi cliché imagery
Generic background node networks or stock particle canvas soups
Heavy glassmorphism cards on white/navy sections that compromise legibility
Random numerical fake metrics (e.g., '99.9% AI accuracy', '10M+ operations')
Fake testimonials, client counters, or corporate logo soups
Vague hype slogans ('the future is here', 'revolutionizing everything')
Scroll hijacking or forced full-screen loading intro animations

display_font.usage: Main headlines, hero title, section overlines, numbers
display_font.style: Sharp geometric sans display, tight tracking (tracking-tight / tracking-tighter), authoritative weight (font-bold / font-black)

body_font.usage: Editorial body text, paragraph leads, case study text

mono_font.usage: Orbital annotations, step markers, code/spec badges, footnote disclaimers, status tags

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-[1.05]

layout_and_grid.asymmetric_swiss_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 align-start

motion_tokens.lenis_momentum: Smooth inertia scrolling enabled via `@studio-freight/lenis` or custom Lenis instance

framer_transitions.mask_reveal: initial: { y: '100%', opacity: 0 }, animate: { y: 0, opacity: 1 }, transition: { duration: 0.9, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }
framer_transitions.path_draw: initial: { pathLength: 0 }, whileInView: { pathLength: 1 }, transition: { duration: 1.4, ease: 'easeOut' }

sections.title: Hero & Signature Orbital Moment
components: Fixed glassmorphic/blur Navigation Header with Emblem, links (POV, Capabilities, Constellation, Responsibility, Contact) and 'Explore Projects' CTA button
Masked line-by-line reveal title: 'Engineering Autonomous Intelligence for the Next Era'
Editorial lead paragraph highlighting superintelligence research and human control
CTA Group: Primary button 'Explore projects' (scrolls to Constellation) + Secondary button 'Discover our approach' (scrolls to How Works)
SVG Interactive Orbital Hero Graphic featuring Cygnus swan emblem, animated rotating orbital ring, 4-point star accent, and plotted coordinate nodes
Subtle Mouse Parallax shift on orbital SVG elements

sections.title: Editorial Velocity Ribbon
components: Slow horizontal drift ribbon with hairline top and bottom gold/teal borders
Monospace editorial phrases separated by custom 4-point star symbols: CYGNUS AI LABS — SUPERINTELLIGENCE RESEARCH — VERIFIED AUTOMATION — HUMAN-DIRECTED GOVERNANCE — LONG-HORIZON ARCHITECTURE

sections.title: Company Point of View (Editorial Asymmetric)
components: Warm neutral off-white background (#F8F7F4) creating stark visual contrast from Hero
Large editorial pull statement: 'We do not build software to replace human judgment. We build cognitive systems that amplify strategic clarity.'
Two-column asymmetrical layout detailing Cygnus core thesis: Precision over hype, Deterministic safety, Long-horizon autonomy
Fine hairline architectural grid lines dividing key thesis cards

sections.title: Capabilities Index & Approved Tags
components: Dark Navy background returning to orbital high-tech aesthetic
Accordion / Index listing core capabilities: 1. High-Order Reasoning Engines, 2. Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows, 3. Deterministic Governance & Guardrails, 4. Embedded Domain Intelligence
Each accordion item contains visible approved tag badges: [ADD APPROVED CAPABILITY] placeholder tag
Expandable drawer revealing execution architecture, inputs, outputs, and safety boundaries

sections.title: How Cygnus Works (Plotted Path)
components: 4-step sequential plotted process path with animated SVG path drawing on scroll
Steps: 01. Domain Decomposition & Mapping -> 02. Constraint & Guardrail Synthesis -> 03. Agentic Mesh Deployment -> 04. Continuous Verification & Calibration
Interactive step nodes highlighting active step on click or scroll position
CRITICAL DISCLAIMER FOOTNOTE: Small monospace footnote at bottom '[PROPOSED APPROACH — CONFIRM]'

sections.title: SIGNATURE SECTION: Interactive Project Constellation & Signal Atlas
components: Interactive SVG Constellation Canvas with 4 major project nodes plotted on curved orbital rings
Connecting fine SVG hairline beams linking project nodes to central Cygnus Core
Node Selection State: Mouse hover / click or keyboard navigation triggers glowing focus rings and reveals detailed case-study panel
Structured Case-Study Detail Panel (Drawer or Modal Card) with explicit placeholders:
Placeholder 1: [PROJECT NAME] — e.g., 'Project Cygnus-Alpha: Orbital Supply Intelligence'
Placeholder 2: [CHALLENGE] — High-latency multi-variable distribution under extreme constraints
Placeholder 3: [CYGNUS CONTRIBUTION] — Multi-agent deterministic routing core with instant failsafe rules
Placeholder 4: [VERIFIED OUTCOME] — 42% reduction in operational latency, zero safety violations
Clear 'Return to Signal Atlas / Close Panel' button for seamless navigation

sections.title: Trust & Responsibility (Principles-as-POV)
components: Warm off-white neutral section focusing on ethical AI principles and human oversight
3 Principles Cards: 1. Human-in-the-Loop Supremacy, 2. Verifiable Audit Trails & Transparency, 3. Zero Black-Box Autonomy
Strict compliance with prohibition rule: NO fake ISO certifications, NO invented badges

sections.title: Contact & Business Direct Link
components: Direct email link CTA: mailto:business@cygnuslabs.si
Visual contact form with placeholders ONLY (Name, Organization, Inquiry Type, Scope Description)
Submit button behavior: Triggers prefilled mailto draft (mailto:business@cygnuslabs.si?subject=Inquiry...), NO backend storage or simulated payload

sections.title: Footer & Emblem Confirmation
components: Cygnus Swan Emblem with 4-point star and orbital ring logo
In-page quick navigation links (Hero, POV, Capabilities, Constellation, Contact)
Confirmed contact email: business@cygnuslabs.si
Copyright & year 2026 note

accessibility_and_responsive.contrast_compliance: APCA and WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios across both Midnight Navy (#010619) and Warm Neutral (#F8F7F4) sections
accessibility_and_responsive.prefers_reduced_motion: Full CSS & Framer Motion `useReducedMotion()` support. Fallback ensures static opacity reveals without animation glitches
accessibility_and_responsive.keyboard_nav: Full tab index focus rings on constellation nodes, accordion items, buttons, and form inputs
accessibility_and_responsive.mobile_first: Designed for 390px mobile viewports first, responsive touch targets (min 44x44px)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app inside `/app/frontend/src/App.js` or modular components inside `/app/frontend/src/components/`.
Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or standard smooth momentum behavior is configured cleanly.
Implement exact logo colors: Midnight Navy #010619, Cobalt #0154C9, Bright Blue #0287DF, Teal #01A498, Warm Gold #FA9720, Coral #FB5040.
Ensure contrast section alternation (Navy -> Warm Neutral -> Navy -> Warm Neutral -> Navy) is strictly followed for breathing room.
Include all explicit required placeholder text verbatim: '[ADD APPROVED CAPABILITY]', '[PROPOSED APPROACH — CONFIRM]', '[PROJECT NAME]', '[CHALLENGE]', '[CYGNUS CONTRIBUTION]', '[VERIFIED OUTCOME]'.
Form submit MUST open mailto:business@cygnuslabs.si with prefilled subject/body.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key text elements as specified.
